suggestions.pitch: Rashee Rice is projected for zero and not producing, so turning his market value into Tyreek Hill and D'Andre Swift gives me two starters from a 1-5 team.
Jermaine Burton is a free-agent bench WR with market value, and Nick Chubb is a usable RB for a fringe lineup spot from a team out of contention.
Spencer Rattler is a bench QB, and Cam Akers plus Dylan Laube add RB depth at little cost.
